bullets.text: Notepad Update Rolls Out - **Microsoft** introduces table support and AI text features in **Notepad** for Windows Insiders.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - **Microsoft** releases Build 26220.7271, featuring Xbox full screen experience and point-in-time restore.
Microsoft Named Leader Again - **Microsoft** recognized as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Access Management.
Holiday Buying Guide - **Windows 11 PCs** with **Copilot** offer unique AI experiences and holiday deals for consumers.
AI Innovations at Ignite - **Microsoft** showcases AI advancements and security innovations at Ignite 2025.
Edge for Business Launch - **Microsoft** unveils Edge for Business, the first secure enterprise AI browser.
AI Agents in Security - **Microsoft Security Copilot** integrates AI agents to enhance cybersecurity for organizations.
New AI Features in Azure - **Microsoft** announces Azure Copilot agents and AI infrastructure innovations at Ignite 2025.
